response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM r) SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - a.mean_rate AS rate_minus_mean FROM r CROSS JOIN a WHERE r.rate > a.mean_rate

assumptions.assumption: Media types are grouped by MediaTypeId (with Name), so each media type counts once in the mean even if names repeat; only types with at least one track appear in the mean.
Track count is the number of matched tracks (COUNT(*)), including tracks with NULL Bytes; NULL Bytes are ignored in the byte sum by SUM.
Rate is bytes per millisecond, computed as a decimal (not integer) division.
